title: kbingest map records each symbol's definition and its references, file by file, at the pinned commit
goal: kbingest.py map adds a symbols section to its JSON map, read with ast for Python: for each definition its name, kind, path and line, and for each its references (path and line) within the repository; the map is written under _cache by default, never under kb/, and its format is 2.

run: import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile;o=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'m.json');s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbingest.py','map','.','--lang','python','--out',o],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900,check=True);m=json.load(open(o));y=m.get('symbols') or [];hit=[x for x in y if x.get('name')=='pack' and x.get('path','').startswith('_tools/')];print(len(y),hit[:2]);sys.exit(0 if hit and hit[0].get('references') else 1)

import glob,json,os,subprocess as s,sys;b=set(s.run(['git','status','--porcelain','--','kb'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines());p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbingest.py','map','.','--lang','python'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900,check=True);a=set(s.run(['git','status','--porcelain','--','kb'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines());f=max(glob.glob('_cache/ingest/*.json'),key=os.path.getmtime);m=json.load(open(f));print(f,m.get('format'),a-b);sys.exit(0 if m.get('format')==2 and 'symbols' in m and not a-b else 1)

clauses.clause: kbingest.py map adds a symbols section to its JSON map, read with ast for Python: for each definition its name, kind, path and line
for each its references (path and line) within the repository
the map is written under _cache by default, never under kb/
